headline: Tokyo,
this evening.
scenes.narration: Maja's flying to Tokyo this evening. FlyRight has been counting down all day — she already knows which terminal to head to.

headline: She opens
the app.
scenes.narration: At the airport, she opens the app, and the live card is right there with her trip.

headline: Everything,
before she needs it.
scenes.narration: Check-in area, gate, boarding time. Everything, before she needs any of it.

headline: Each step,
as she goes.
scenes.narration: She taps each step as she goes, and her friends and family get notified about every one.

headline: One tap.
Her pass.
scenes.narration: At the gate, or in duty free, she taps the pass right on the live card.

headline: Always
up to date.
scenes.narration: And the live card keeps her updated the whole way, on the Home Screen and the Lock Screen.

headline: Her plane,
on its line.
scenes.narration: On the World tab, her plane rides its own line across a globe FlyRight drew itself.

headline: Everywhere
she has been.
scenes.narration: And everywhere she's been, all over the world.

headline: Her trips,
as a poster.
bullets: One trip, or all of them
A glow where she flies most
scenes.narration: And she can share a trip, or all of her trips, as a poster.

headline: Updates
from her people.
scenes.narration: On the Updates tab she catches up on her friends' trips — Tomas, just home, and Clara, still in the air.

headline: Tap one.
Follow it.
scenes.narration: Tap one of the followers, and you follow their whole day.

headline: And she can
share hers.
scenes.narration: And she can share her own updates too — a line or a photo, straight to her people.

headline: Wheels down.
Belt twelve.
bullets: The belt, before she looks for it
scenes.narration: Wheels down in Tokyo. FlyRight already tells her which belt her bags are on — no looking around for it.

headline: What she's
owed.
bullets: Raise the claim from the app
scenes.note: Sample delay · eligibility depends on the circumstances
scenes.narration: If it runs late, it works out what she's owed.

headline: Free to keep.
Pro to travel.
scenes.narration: Keeping flights and following people is free. Pro is the live day: gate, delay, belt, and postcards.

headline: Her followers
see it free.
scenes.narration: Her followers see all of it free. Monthly, yearly, or lifetime, through RevenueCat.

headline: One place
for the whole journey.
scenes.narration: FlyRight. One place for the whole journey.
